name: YFG FutureIsDark [Flux | ZIB | Krea2]
description: YFG FutureIsDark – Flux | ZIB Dark Biomech Epic Style A cinematic dark-sci-fi / gothic aesthetic: moody chiaroscuro, deep green-black palettes with teal/amber or cold gold accents, intricate biomechanical motifs (cables, ribbed armor, tube-like ornament), and mythic, high-drama compositions—thrones, serpents, void skylines, and armored figures in storm-lit landscapes. Trigger No dedicated trigger. Guide with cues like “biomechanical,” “gothic sci-fi,” “void-lit,” “cathedral machinery,” “serpentine conduit,” “throne of cables,” or “cosmic storm.” Training / Steps Trained for 750 steps as a Flux-2 Dev style LoRA . Strength Tested 0.45 – 1.50 . ≈ 0.75 is a balanced midpoint (strong style without crushing prompt detail). Lower weights for subtle gloom and texture; higher weights for dense cabling, darker tones, and monumental drama. Key Characteristics Biomech Ornament – Ribbed conduits, plated masks, cable “roots,” embossed armor. Mythic Scale – Thrones, titanic serpents, cosmic backdrops, cathedral-like halls. Dark Cinematic Lighting – Hard rim light, volumetric shafts, reflective wet surfaces. Textural Grit – Weathered metals, etched plates, micro-pitting and wear. Cosmic & Occult Hints – Spirals, starfields, sigils, planetary alignments. Prompt Ideas “Gothic biomechanical queen on a throne of cables, void cathedral interior, cold teal rim light, high detail.” “Colossal serpent of conduits coiled around a lamppost in space fog, glowing blue eyes, cinematic lighting.” “Armored paladin in a storm-lit alpine ravine, reflective water swirls, dark fantasy sci-fi fusion.” “Close-up plated visage with cable filigree, near-black palette, subtle golden accents, moody chiaroscuro.” “Ancient cosmic temple with ribbed machinery arches, pilgrims in silhouette, volumetric shafts of light.” Tips & Tricks Light the Metal – Add “neon/teal rim light,” “volumetric fog,” “backlit smoke,” or “wet reflective ground” to sell depth. Control Density – If scenes get too busy, drop strength to 0.6–0.7 or use negatives like “fewer cables,” “avoid clutter.” Palette Direction – Specify “gunmetal + teal,” “black-green with cold gold,” or “blue-white stars and amber highlights.” Scale Cues – Phrases like “monumental,” “cathedral,” “colossal,” “wide-angle” amplify epic scope. Blend Wisely – When stacking with other LoRAs (e.g., character or environment), keep YFG FutureIsDark around 0.6–0.9 so its biomech mood enhances rather than overwhelms. Forge vast, brooding visions—where machinery becomes myth and darkness glows—from subtle gloom to full FutureIsDark grandeur by tuning weight and lighting to taste.
